# Test pe run command functionality

env PE_TEST_MODE=true
env PE_MOCK_PROVIDER=true

# Test basic usage - simple math prompt
pe run 'What is 2+2?' --stream=false
stdout '4'
! stderr .

# Test basic usage - direct text prompt
pe run 'Hello world' --stream=false
stdout 'Mock response for: Hello world'
! stderr .

# Test with no arguments - should fail
! pe run
stderr .

# Test file input - read from file
pe run prompt.txt --stream=false
stdout '<answer>The capital of France is Paris</answer>'
! stderr .

# Test file input - nonexistent file treated as direct text
pe run nonexistent.txt --stream=false
stdout 'Mock response for: nonexistent.txt'
! stderr .

# Test template variable substitution
pe run 'Hello {{.name}}' --var name=World --stream=false
stdout 'Hello World|Mock response for: Hello World'
! stderr .

# Test multiple variables
pe run '{{.greeting}} {{.name}}!' --var greeting=Hello --var name=Alice --stream=false
stdout 'Hello Alice!|Mock response for: Hello Alice!'
! stderr .

# Test template with no substitution
pe run 'Simple prompt' --var unused=value --stream=false
stdout 'Mock response for: Simple prompt'
! stderr .

# Test different providers
pe run 'Test prompt' --stream=false
! stderr .

pe run 'Test prompt' --provider cgpt --stream=false
! stderr .

pe run 'Test prompt' --provider mock --stream=false
! stderr .

# Test stream flag
pe run 'test prompt' --stream
! stderr .

# Test stream disabled
pe run 'test prompt' --stream=false
! stderr .

-- prompt.txt --
What is the capital of France?
